research: VERIFIED ONLINE: (1) Garena vs Global are two fully separate games — separate publishers (Garena SEA vs Activision), servers, accounts, redeem codes and CP economies; a Garena SG/MY Player ID does NOT work for Global top-ups and vice versa (lootbar, brgeeks, seagm, elitedias). (2) Attempting to transfer/shift an account between builds is punishable by ban — confirmed in multiple community/guide sources, so the region article must WARN, not advise. (3) Player ID location confirmed twice: in-game Settings (top-right) -> User Settings -> Player ID shown at the bottom near 'Legal and Privacy'. (4) Garena SG/MY CP tiers are odd-numbered with bonus CP (114 / 230+23 / 460+69 / 690+104 / 1150+173 / 2300+460 / 4600+1840 / 6858+2744 / 11429+4572 on SEAGM) and differ from Global's round 500/1100/2400/5000 — useful proof that 'which version' changes what you buy. (5) Battle Pass ~560 CP; Lucky Draw is an escalating ladder (25/70/180/360/580/900/1400/2800/4000 CP in one Garena draw, ~10,315 CP total). (6) Codashop's own guidance: they never ask for PlayerID AND password — good trust framing. COMPETITION READ (verified): the Uzbek-language SERP for CODM top-up is effectively EMPTY. Searches in Uzbek Latin ('codm cp to'ldirish o'zbekiston', 'call of duty mobile cp sotib olish uzbekistan') return only YouTube gameplay clips and irrelevant Telegram-bot blog posts — zero commercial pages. The Russian CODM SERP is owned by .ru donate shops (donatov.net, dem-gold, coolgameservice, szmarket, kupikod, ggsel, funpay) plus Codashop KZ — none of which accept UzCard/HUMO/so'm, so 'узбекистан / сум / humo uzcard' modifiers are wide open. By contrast the Uzbek PUBG UC SERP is already contested (Midasbuy UZ, Payme blog, 1pay.uz, hablax, mtcgame, milliysavdo.store) — proof that Uzbek-language money pages DO rank here, and that CODM is the same opportunity with no incumbent. The Telegram-Premium niche (uzgets.uz, starsjoy.uz) shows the exact winning page pattern for this audience: Uzbek Latin + 'so'm' + UzCard/Humo/Click/Payme + bot. INFERRED (not verified with volume data — Ahrefs and Semrush connectors are unauthorized in this session, so there are NO real volume/KD numbers here): relative ordering of the keyword lists, the transliterated spellings ('kod mobayl', 'codm'), and the assumption that a meaningful share of Uzbek CODM players sit on the Garena SG/MY build. That last assumption is exactly why article #2 is written as an identification guide rather than a recommendation — a Global-account reader must be told the honest answer, not pushed into a purchase.
